items.title: How to Sign In & Access Your Workspace
items.summary: Learn how signing in unlocks your Toolify workspace, saves preferences, and keeps sessions organized.
steps: Go to the login screen and sign in with your authorized Toolify account.
Once authenticated, you will be routed to the workspace and available tools.
If a session expires or looks stuck, sign out once and log back in cleanly.
items.whatsappPrefill: Hi Kawsar, I need help signing in / accessing my Toolify account.

items.title: How to Find & Run Tools Smoothly
items.summary: Navigate across utilities, provide input data, and get instant results without friction.
steps: Open the Tools section and pick the utility you need (text, code, generator, calculator, or converter).
Enter your input or settings carefully inside the tool panel.
Run the action, copy or download the output, and switch to another tool anytime.
items.whatsappPrefill: Hi Kawsar, I have a question about using one of the tools on Toolify.

items.title: Switching Between English & Bangla (EN / বাং) and Dark / Light Mode
items.summary: Customize your reading language and screen brightness across pages seamlessly.
steps: Use the EN / বাং toggle button in the header to switch between English and Bangla.
Use the theme toggle button to switch between Light and Dark appearance.
Refresh the page if needed—saved browser preferences will stay applied.
items.whatsappPrefill: Hi Kawsar, I noticed an issue with language (EN/BN) or theme switching on Toolify.

items.title: Understanding Free & Premium Access and Billing
items.summary: See what is included on Free vs. Premium and what to do if you need billing support.
steps: Start with Free access to explore core features and standard usage limits.
Upgrade to Premium when you need higher limits or expanded workspace capabilities.
For payment or refund questions, keep your transaction reference handy and reach out.

items.title: How to Request a New Tool or Feature
items.summary: Have an idea for a helpful utility or workflow improvement on Toolify? Share it with Kawsar.
steps: Write down what the tool should do, what input it takes, and what output you expect.
Check if a similar utility already exists in the tools list.
Send your idea via WhatsApp or the Contact page so Kawsar can review it for future updates.

items.title: Fixing Display Glitches, Stale Cache, or Loading Issues
items.summary: Quick steps to resolve layout glitches, outdated text, or browser cache problems.
steps: Hard-refresh the page (Ctrl + Shift + R or Cmd + Shift + R) to load fresh assets.
Temporarily pause aggressive ad-blockers or extensions if a UI element looks blocked.
If the issue continues, share a screenshot with Kawsar on WhatsApp.
